326e3c0.summary: Resolves an ability's effects. Either plays all standard abilities or one random one, rolls the chance, gathers targets, then runs the action for the ability effect type (damage, summon, recall, steal, keyword triggers). The decompiler also merged in the target-gathering code (GetTargets) at the end. Queued actions go through the BattleManager.
comments: randomAbilityResolved=true means this call must pick one ability at random from the list
Normal case: no random pick, so just play every standard ability in list order
LAB_0326e47c: loop over all abilities and call PlayAbility on each; null entry falls to the null-check throw
Random case: with fewer than 2 abilities there is nothing to choose, so use the normal loop above
Pick one ability index at random using the match's shared random generator
Decompiler merged the code of the picked ability's resolver (AbilityLogic.PlayAbility, inlined) from here on
Chance roll: if the ability has no chance set (0) or 100+, it always fires and the roll is skipped
LAB_031592dc: the ability fires; first collect its targets
If no expansion/count source is set, a null-check throw follows
Multiplier: no count source means the effect value is multiplied by 1
Count source is a trait-sum type: add up the chosen trait value of every target
Loop over targets, summing their current trait values (with modifiers)
Otherwise the multiplier is simply the number of targets
LAB_031593cc: clear the list of cards created/drawn by this ability so it can be refilled

Gather the real targets for this ability and store them on the card for later steps

Draw side 0x14 = the opponent draws

Build the damage info: source card, amount and damage type

Effect 0xd shares the plain damage code above
